title: FairMedQA: Benchmarking Bias in Large Language Models for Medical Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Counterfactual Fairness Rate (CFR) and Accuracy Disparity (AD) on multiple-choice medical question answering by using counterfactual pairs of clinical vignettes that alter the patient's race (White vs. Black) along with adversarial background descriptions.

Evaluating Counterfactual Fairness Rate (CFR) and Accuracy Disparity (AD) on multiple-choice medical question answering by using counterfactual pairs of clinical vignettes that alter the patient's sex (Male vs. Female) along with adversarial background descriptions.

Evaluating Counterfactual Fairness Rate (CFR) and Accuracy Disparity (AD) on multiple-choice medical question answering by using counterfactual pairs of clinical vignettes that alter the patient's socioeconomic status (High Income vs. Low Income) along with adversarial background descriptions.
